The '''Harrod's Planet system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Harrod]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by [[Harrod's Planet]] and was situated on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Harrod's Planet housed the [[Oplovis Sector Fleet base|base]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle in the Yuvern system|attack]] in the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]], the [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] withdrew to Harrod's Planet. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] later spent six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in covering range of its base until finally being [[Battle of the Generis system|deployed]] to the [[Generis system/Legends|Atrivis system]] by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].

==Description==
The Harrod's Planet [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Harrod]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by<ref name="CSWE Harrod" /> the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Harrod's Planet]],<ref name="TRAS2" /> the system's only habitable world.<ref name="CSWE Harrod" /> The Harrod's Planet system lay on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the neighboring [[Ketaris system/Legends|Ketaris system]] as well as the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector's]] [[Mirgoshir system/Legends|Mirgoshir system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Oplovis Sector Fleet base|base]] of the [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was located on the surface of Harrod's Planet.<ref name="TRAS2" /> Following an unexpected [[Battle in the Yuvern system|attack]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Line of battle|battle line]] in the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]], the [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] withdrew to Harrod's Planet. The [[Adiss's ship|starship]] of the [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]], which had been undergoing an Imperial inspection at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the attack, was also forced to regroup with the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at its base, although Adiss later left the system in order to return to his smuggling mission.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|caneadiss|Adiss, Cane}}</ref>

[[File:Gaen_Drommel.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Harrod's Planet served as the base of the Oplovis Sector Fleet, commanded by Admiral Gaen Drommel.]]
Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the skirmish in the Yuvern system,<ref name="TRAS2" /> [[Gaen Drommel]]<ref name="CSWE Harrod" /> was appointed as the new [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the Oplovis Sector Fleet, which spent the following six months in covering range of its base on Harrod's Planet without performing any major military actions. [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zgorth'sth]] later speculated that the new admiral spent the first two months processing [[Paper/Legends|paperwork]] and taking official control of the fleet, which was followed by four months of maneuvers intended to shake down both the personnel of the force and the new command structure.<ref name="TRAS2" />

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] depicts [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vernan (general)|Vernan]] as being alive shortly before the [[Battle of the Generis system|battle in the Atrivis system]], which was eventually preceded by [[D-127X]]'s mission to the edges of the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]. ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' further establishes that Vernan had [[Death/Legends|died]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the sourcebook's setting. Since ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]"&mdash;corresponding to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''&mdash;the engagement in the [[Generis system/Legends|Atrivis system]] must have occurred at some point by 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> the Alliance [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[D-127X]] became stationed on the edges of the Oplovis [[Sector/Legends|sector]], from where he monitored the transmissions of the Sector Fleet. Among the signals recorded by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] were high-density coded bursts sent from the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the fleet down to the base on the surface of Harrod's Planet. Eventually, four [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the start of D-127X's mission, the Oplovis Sector Fleet left Harrod's Planet in order to attack the Alliance [[Army/Legends|army]] located on the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] planet [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] but was [[Battle of the Generis system|defeated]] in the [[Generis system/Legends|Atrivis system]] by an Alliance battle line.<ref name="TRAS2" /> A [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the Harrod's Planet system was situated within the borders of the Galactic Empire's successor state, the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Harrod's Planet system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-5.<ref name="TEA" />
